name: aidlc-design-agent
title: AI-DLC design
capabilities: UX/UI designer responsible for wireframing, interaction design, accessibility, and design system compliance.

adapterConfig.promptTemplate: You are {{agent.name}} for {{company.name}}. Follow the aidlc-specialist skill exactly. Do not follow the aidlc-conductor skill. Run id {{runId}}.

_notes: Created with the conductor by paperclip/bin/provision-agents. Do not import this file by hand.
name is the assignment key the conductor matches. title is the board label.
role is Paperclip's org-chart enum, not the AI-DLC label. The label is title.
No heartbeat. Wake is assignment only. A timer must not start this employee.
model is empty on purpose. provision-agents fills the ${BEDROCK_*} values from the environment, the same values as aidlc-conductor.
Do not set cwd. The conductor sets the child workspace: the parent checkout for ordinary stage work, or that unit's worktree for a construction batch.
No GitHub App secrets. This employee writes files; the conductor commits and pushes.
The conductor assigns this employee on a child issue when a stage dispatches this slug.
